name: building-driving-center-visual
description: Frames a built tier-1 driving centre (Learner's Lot) at the camera distance the game actually plays at, so the model can be inspected: the chalkboard, the restraint chair under its lamp and the pupil bench have to read as a classroom rather than as a junk lot (#1011). Yaw 180 looks at the door row (+Y), which is the only side the classroom is open from — the back wall carries the chalkboard, so any yaw near 0 photographs the outside of that wall. Distance 7 is what the building fills the frame at without leaving normal play framing.

steps.description: Hired before the build order: ordering a building only queues the work, so someone has to be on the roster to walk over and put it up.

Placed at 20,5. Two other tiles were tried first and both failed for reasons only a screenshot or CI could show: 5,5 — the row the other building-visual files use — sits on the face of a dune under seed 42, and the ridge in front of it hides everything below the door lintels from any camera the shot can reach; 25,15 placed fine on every local run but CI refused it with 'Uneven surface', so the voxel column heights there differ between the two environments. 20,5 is where building-training-visual already puts a tier-1 geology_lab, which has the same 2x2 footprint and passes CI, and it frames flat.

Lets the queued site be walked to and built out, so the shot above frames a finished building rather than its scaffold. The toolbar's Build tab is clicked first to toggle the build panel shut, so the shot frames the building rather than a third of a screen of menu.
